RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Seattle operates under a mayor-council form of government. The Mayor is elected citywide. The City Council consists of nine members; seven are elected by district, and two are elected citywide (at-large). Sara Nelson serves as the Council President. Information is based on current data from seattle.gov and Wikipedia.
